example_prompt: Run every revenue check you can against my store and rank what's leaking money.
intents: find where my store is losing money
run all the revenue playbooks against my store
audit my store for revenue leaks
what's broken in my ads, emails and checkout
check everything I've connected for wasted spend
what should I fix first to make more money
run the leak check again: what's fixed and what's still open
reads: the public revenue playbook index (playbooks/playbooks-index.json on the goose-skills main branch, or the local checkout; each playbook's own file as fallback): ask, steps, check, then, cadence — written by the playbooks library
the marketer's own tools, read-only: ad platforms, store, email tool, analytics, Merchant Center, Amazon — through their connectors or exports

Google Analytics through analytics_read and the brand's own TikTok/Instagram through social_account_list + social_analytics_get, when the brand connected them in GooseWorks; meta_read performance as a cross-check only (GooseWorks-made ads)
public pages through the host's browser, fetch and web search: the store as a shopper sees it, the Meta Ad Library, reviews, DNS records, coupon sites, competitors' sites

brand brain (brand_knowledge_browse / read / search where listed, else brand_read lean + knowledge_search): products, shipping countries, margins, sending domain, competitors, offers, accounts — the server's research, the app, research-competitors (competitor list)
its own last run record runs/find-revenue-leaks/<job-slug>/<date>.md — run-memory
run-paid-campaigns' decisions.md blocks and email-lifecycle's files, as outcome sources for fixes handed to them
local mode: gooseworks-local/<brand-slug>/ (brand-notes.md, its reports and run records) — the marketing-guide skill (../marketing-guide/SKILL.md) §5
writes: the report — local gooseworks-reports/<brand-slug>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-revenue-leaks.md (or an artifact in hosted chat) via write-report, plus reports/revenue-leaks/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md and brand document 'Revenue leak check — <Brand> — <date>' (keep-history) — read by the marketer and this job's next run

run records runs/find-revenue-leaks/<job-slug>/<date>.md + brand documents (keep-history) via run-memory — coverage, findings with keys and status vs last run, clean checks, recommendations — read by its own next run
reports/revenue-leaks/method/ (copied method for the scheduled worker) — read by the automation
optional monthly or weekly automation, created paused — automation_upsert (switched on by the marketer)
research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md for any paid read via spend-gate — read by every proxy user
learnings the marketer states, via save-learning — read by every playbook
local mode: the same report and run records under gooseworks-local/<brand-slug>/; rules to brand-notes.md

needs.gooseworks: optional — without it, local mode (the marketing-guide skill, ../marketing-guide/SKILL.md §5): the marketer's own connectors (read-only), exports, screenshots and the host's browser
connectors_optional: ads-platform, store, email-tool, analytics, Merchant Center or marketplace connector (read-only)
